offering_description.value: Designs and sources apparel, footwear and accessories under owned and licensed labels, primarily for department stores and other retailers. It uses contract manufacturers and also sells directly to consumers through its stores and e-commerce sites.

primary_products.value: sportswear and dresses; outerwear; swimwear; handbags and accessories; footwear

customer_segment.value: B2B: Department stores, specialty retailers, online retailers and brand licensees; B2C: Shoppers buying fashion apparel, footwear and accessories

end_markets.value: fashion apparel, footwear and accessories retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wholesale orders from retailers and consumer purchases in stores and online; licensing or royalties: Third-party rights to use company-owned fashion trademarks

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops fashion collections and contracts production for retail accounts and consumers; distributor: Sources finished goods under owned and licensed labels and supplies retail accounts; retailer: Sells its fashion collections to consumers through stores and e-commerce sites

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with operations and sales in Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Apparel, outerwear, swimwear, footwear and accessories across owned and licensed labels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Wholesale sales to department stores, specialty chains and online retailers; third-party retail: Department stores and specialty retailers selling its collections to consumers; own locations: Company-operated fashion boutiques and outlet stores; online: Company-operated brand e-commerce sites and third-party retail websites
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; third-party retail; own locations; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Textile labeling, apparel flammability and customs rules enforced by the FTC, CPSC and customs authorities

notes: The exact mix of active third-party apparel licenses is uncertain.
